packageRules.description: Skip floating :latest tags (we want to stay on latest by restarting pods)
one pr per app with all its chart and image bumps (majors included), named after the app folder
linuxserver qbittorrent still has old ubuntu style tags like 20.04.1 that look newer than 5.x, ignore them
hold gluetun on 3.40: with 3.41.3 the nordvpn wireguard tunnel passes no traffic and the startup healthcheck loops (2026-11-14), retry later
all github actions bumps in one pr
kubernetes can't skip minor versions, so k3s gets one pr per minor, merge them in order

customManagers.description: versions annotated with a # renovate: comment, like k3s_version in host_vars
